answer: Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 208 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the karst funding graph is rebuilt from the jade history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 208 bonds yet holds one position, and the kernel report publishes the merged exposure. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
